claim: The novel-looking ionizable lipid is named 'CEE-E12'
locus_B: main text Materials 2.1 ('CKK-E12 was purchased from MedChemExpress'), Table 1, SI Tables S2+S3, and the authors' own repo code list ['SM-102','MC-3','ALC-0315','CKK-E12'] in 2 files
measurement: 1 source says CEE-E12, 6 independent loci say CKK-E12
why: Typo in the Source Data workbook. cKK-E12 is a known 2014 Anderson-lab lipidoid sold by MedChemExpress; 'CEE-E12' matches no reagent.

claim: Formulation number N means the same formulation in the workbook and in the paper
locus_A: mmc2.xlsx column A, block order ALC-0315(1-7), CKK-E12(8-13), MC-3(14-19), SM-102(20-25)
locus_B: SI Table S2 + every figure x-axis, block order ALC-0315(1-7), SM-102(8-13), MC-3(14-19), CKK-E12(20-25)
measurement: Composition bijection is PERFECT 25/25: 13 formulations sit at the same index, 12 are permuted as a clean two-block swap with within-block order preserved (S2 #8->xlsx #20 ... #13->#25; #20->#8 ... #25->#13)
why: The lipid type travels with the COMPOSITION identically in mmc2 and Table S2, but Figs 4c/5c plot the workbook in SHEET order while labelling the x-axis groups in Table S2 order. One of the two bindings is wrong and they disagree about which molecule 12 measured values belong to.

claim: Abstract: 'SM-102- and CKK-E12-based formulations ... reduced to 0.0744 and 0.0611, respectively'
locus_B: mmc2.xlsx column V: 0.074417 sits on the row the workbook names CKK-E12; 0.061063 on the row it names SM-102
measurement: Both values are exact to 4 dp; under the workbook/Table S2 naming the 'respectively' pairing is REVERSED. Under the figure-label naming it is exactly right.
why: This is the single strongest piece of evidence for the figure-label reading, and it is why D-1 is genuinely two-sided rather than a clerical slip.

claim: Section 3.4: 'MC3-based LNPs consistently produced high knockdown efficiencies'
locus_B: mmc2.xlsx column V, MC-3 block (formulations 14-19, whose position is NOT disputed by either reading)
measurement: MC-3 relative expression mean 0.7509 (range 0.6188-0.8306) = 24.9% mean knockdown, the WEAKEST of the four lipids; SM-102 block mean 0.1801 = 82.0%
why: Holds under BOTH readings of D-1 because the MC-3 block occupies formulations 14-19 in both orderings. The narrative is simply not supported by the Source Data.

claim: Section 3.4: 'CKK-E12-based LNPs demonstrated the strongest silencing effect'
measurement: Block means: SM-102-named 0.1801, CKK-E12-named 0.3206. Under the workbook naming SM-102 is stronger and the sentence is false; under the figure-label naming CKK-E12 is stronger and it is true.
why: Reading-dependent, so it discriminates rather than merely contradicts.

claim: Section 3.4: 'For ALC-0315, formulation 7 was chosen' for the in-vivo arm
locus_B: SI Table S3 row 1 = ALC-0315, DOPC, 5 mM, 40/10/1.5 = Table S2 formulation #5, not #7 (#7 is ALC-0315, DSPC, 5 mM, 60/4/0.5)
measurement: 3 of the 4 in-vivo formulations in Table S3 match the text (#13 SM-102, #19 MC-3, #24 CKK-E12); the ALC-0315 one does not
what_we_emitted: NOTHING - the in-vivo arm is inadmissible anyway
why: Does not affect any admissible value; recorded because it is a second independent indexing inconsistency in the same paper.

claim: Section 3.2.3: Table S2 lists composition, predicted size, predicted PDI, measured size and PDI, cellular uptake and gene silencing efficiency
locus_B: SI Table S2 as published: 26 rows x 7 columns, composition only
measurement: 0 of the 6 promised measurement columns are present
why: The promised joint table does not exist; mmc2.xlsx is the only place composition and measurement meet on one row, which is precisely why D-1 cannot be settled from the SI.

claim: mmc2.xlsx column V is 'Fluorescence intensity of S100P-siRNA-LNP'
locus_B: Fig 5c y-axis 'S100P/GAPDH mRNA expression (fold change relative to control)' with an Untreated bar at 1.0; the two abstract values 0.0744 and 0.0611 both appear in column V

claim: RETRACTED SUSPICION: the workbook's ionizable-lipid LABELS for 12 rows are simply swapped
locus_A: my own first reading, from the abstract's exact values plus the text's formulation indices plus the uptake ranking
locus_B: SI Table S2 composition bijection, and the paper's own Fig 3a correlation result
measurement: RETIRED BY: (a) the 25/25 composition bijection, in which the lipid name travels with the composition identically in mmc2 and Table S2; (b) the ILC discriminator - the paper reports ILC correlates POSITIVELY with size for SM-102 (rho=0.64, the strongest) and NEGATIVELY for CKK-E12, and the screen selected for SMALL size, so CKK-E12's selected set should sit at HIGH concentration and SM-102's at LOW. Measured: the CKK-E12-named block has mean ILC 8.54 mM with 5/6 at the 10 mM maximum; the SM-102-named block has mean ILC 3.13 mM with 0/6 at 10 mM. That matches the workbook naming.
what_we_emitted: NOTHING - converted into the two-sided D-1
why: I was about to adopt one side confidently. The AC_2025 precedent is exactly this shape, and its first repair was confident, internally consistent, and would have put 419 measured values on the wrong molecules.
